heroTitle: Evidence-Based Research for India's Economic Future
heroSubtitle: Interdisciplinary analysis spanning law, economics, public policy, and finance. Rigorous research accessible to every citizen.
missionStatement: BharatkiEconomy exists to democratize high-rigor research, datasets, and economic insights for Indian citizens and market actors.
missionDetail: We combine law, economics, policy, and finance into an interdisciplinary, evidence-based research portal. Every claim is verified. Every dataset is open. Every analysis serves the public interest.
civicHubDescription: Research briefs tailored for informed voters, civic advocates, students, and youth. Complex policy made accessible through plain-language summaries and verified data.
marketPortalDescription: Analytical research for impact investors, VC fund managers, corporate ESG teams, and financial analysts. Evidence-driven insights into regulatory trends and economic indicators.
editorialPrinciples: Every publication opens with a plain-language summary of 3-4 sentences
All data points paired with inline primary source citations
Zero tolerance for unverified claims or sensationalized language
Technical terms isolated in dedicated terminology callout boxes
No partisan political messaging or clickbait patterns
All datasets published under open-access licenses
